scenes.line1: Would you spot a silent data shift?
scenes.say: Would you notice if your data quietly changed overnight? How do you catch subtle shifts before they become big problems?

scenes.label: Silent
scenes.sub: Distribution shifts reveal bugs or fraud others miss.
scenes.say: Distribution shifts can reveal subtle bugs or even fraud that basic checks miss. That's why they matter.

rows.b: Check for bugs or data issues

scenes.say: Here's how it works. First, track stats like mean, median, and histograms. Next, set thresholds to alert on big changes. Finally, investigate alerts for bugs or data issues.

scenes.title: Distribution alert in action
scenes.say: For example, if the average order amount jumps from one hundred to five hundred, you'll get an alert for a significant shift.

scenes.question: What if you skip distribution checks?
scenes.wrong: You catch all data bugs anyway.
scenes.right: You might miss outliers, skew, or silent errors.
scenes.say: What happens if you skip distribution checks? You might miss outliers, data skew, or silent errors that basic tests can't catch.
